analysis.interpretation: Conditional experimental effect under frozen historical trust and supplied inputs; not unlearning or a new secure checkpoint.

proposal_metrics.absence_convention: not_submitted pads missing and removed runtime slots; protocol-rejection history is unchanged
proposal_metrics.interpretation: J includes removal itself; neither J nor Delta alone proves an indirect scoring effect or malice

interpretation: Full historical admission recomputed for every supplied graph round; exact selection bound to interventions and, when supplied, anchored attributed reviews. Standalone verifier flags retain their narrower meaning. No fresh training, quote, witness deadline, global artifact closure or semantic truth is inferred.

limitations: A valid attributed judgment is not ground truth or a causal finding.
Without a trusted external head, an internally valid rollback/fork may be invisible.
Historical numerical execution requires its preserved source release and environment.
reviews.semantic_projection_rule: latest attributed judgment per submission, not consensus or truth

structural_radius.interpretation: Recorded dependency in the supplied evidence graph; neither damage nor a demonstrated numerical change.
structural_radius.path_rule: one shortest witness per reachable edge-type set; no multiplication of coefficients along mixed paths
